home_tagline_body: A portfolio management lab with real Indonesian stock prices.
app_simulation_notice: Simulation. No real money and no real trades.
language_unknown_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field {field}, but Portolab is only available in {languages}. Choose one of them in the language switch.
language_page_body: Choose a language with the switch at the top of the page.
language_rejected_title: The language could not be changed
language_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field {field} instead of text. Choose {languages} in the language switch.
language_missing_error: The form sent no language in the field {field}. Choose {languages} in the language switch.
app_not_found_body: This address does not exist in Portolab. Check the address again, or go back to the home page.
app_unexpected_error_body: Portolab could not show this page. Try reloading the page. If the problem continues, tell your lecturer.
market_data_delay_notice: Prices are delayed by about {minutes} minutes and come from {source}. The latest price was recorded at {time} WIB.
market_data_empty_body: Portolab is fetching its first prices now. Reload this page in a moment to see them.
market_data_update_failed_notice: Portolab could not update the prices at {time} WIB, so the prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_empty_failed_body: Portolab has no prices yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_one_stale_price_notice: Portolab could not update the price of {codes} at {time} WIB, so the {codes} price below is the last one it stored.
market_data_several_stale_prices_notice: Portolab could not update the prices of {codes} at {time} WIB, so their prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_one_missing_price_notice: Portolab has no price for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch it at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_several_missing_prices_notic: Portolab has no prices for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
trading_missing_rules_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded the IDX rules for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_no_price_error: Portolab has no price for {code} yet, so it cannot check the order. Try again once Portolab shows a price for {code}.
trading_outside_universe_error: {code} is not in the LQ45 on {date}, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45 of the trading day. Choose a stock that is in the LQ45 on that day.
trading_too_few_returns_error: {code} has {returns}, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only when each of its stocks has {minimum}. You can buy {code} after the first trading day of {month} closes, when it has enough.
trading_too_many_lots_error: IDX accepts at most {maximum} in one order, but this order has {lots}. Split it into orders of at most {maximum} each.
trading_outside_limits_error: IDX rejects a price of {price} for {code} on {date} by its auto rejection limits, which allow a price at most {upper} above and {lower} below the reference price of {reference}, the close of the previous trading day. Choose a price from {lowest} to {highest}.
trading_off_tick_error: IDX accepts prices from {from} to below {to} only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range, so {price} is not a valid price. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_off_tick_top_error: IDX accepts prices of {from} and above only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range, so {price} is not a valid price. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_purchase_cost_error: Buying {lots} of {code} at {price} costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash is {available}.
trading_set_aside_cash_error: Your open buy orders set aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash} until they fill or expire.
trading_largest_purchase_error: The largest order that your available cash pays for at {price} is {lots}.
trading_no_affordable_lot_error: Your available cash does not pay for 1 lot at {price}. Choose a lower price or another stock, or sell shares that you hold to add to your cash.
trading_price_rose_error: Portolab did not fill your market order to buy {lots} of {code}, because the price rose from {checkedPrice} to {price} while the order waited. At {price} the order costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash was {available}.
trading_sale_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, and you hold {held}.
trading_no_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, but you hold no shares of {code}, and you can sell only shares that you hold. Choose a stock that your portfolio holds.
trading_set_aside_shares_error: Your open sell orders set aside {setAside} of them until they fill or expire.
trading_no_free_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once one of those orders expires, or after you buy more of them.
trading_no_price_history_error: Portolab has not stored a complete month of the price history of {instrument} yet, so it cannot count whether {code} has the monthly returns that the measures need. Try again later.
trading_no_reference_close_error: Portolab has not stored the close of {code} on {date} yet, and IDX sets the range of prices of a limit order from that close. Try again later, or place a market order, which needs no limit.
